title: Inherited command-line map options retain their fallback values
summary: Inherited -Dkey now inserted a present key with a null value. Root and subcommand parsing agreed on both null and an independently configured empty string.

change.description: Copying an inherited option or positional parameter into a subcommand now includes its mapFallbackValue. An option entry without an explicit value should therefore reach the parent’s map with the configured value.

notes: Inheritance changes where the option can be spelled, while fallback belongs to the declared option. The two distinct map values expose an incorrect copy even when parse succeeds.
